title: Adolfo and the Photo tour  was the highlight of our trip to Spain!
text: Our experience with Adolfo was hands down one of our best experiences in Spain. He made the experience something to remember. Every place that we shot had character and the photos turned out to be the best photos we have ever taken in our life. Adolfo’s english was the best I encountered while in Spain and it helped so much to have someone from the area who could explain Granada to us. I would absolutely hire Adolfo again to take photos of us, regardless of where the location was at. We were also blown away by how good of a price Adolfo gave us for such quality photos and a tour of the city. I

title: PhotoWalk with Adolfo
text:
This is my first ever review. I am a half decent photographer myself and wanted a local perspective during our stay in Granada. So I booked a late evening stroll with Adolfo. I brought my wife along and my own camera as well. We walked through the streets of this old town learning from Adolfo some interesting facts about the place while he kept taking some awesome pictures of ours through his amazing Sony dslr system 85 mm prime lens.
